items.message: @Roth.RSet : {σ : Type u_1} → ℝ → (σ → ℕ) → Set (MvPolynomial σ ℤ)

def Roth.RSet.{u_1} : {σ : Type u_1} → ℝ → (σ → ℕ) → Set (MvPolynomial σ ℤ) :=
fun {σ} B r ↦ {R | R ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j R ≤ r j) ∧ ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(R.coeff d)| ≤ B}
RSET179_FULL_TYPE: {σ : Type u_1} → ℝ → (σ → ℕ) → Set (MvPolynomial σ ℤ)
